import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    static final long infinity = 1000000009L;
    static int source, sink;
    static List<List<Integer>> G;
    static List<Edge> e;

    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long flow, capacity;
        Edge(int u, int v, long flow, long capacity) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.capacity = capacity;
        }
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long capacity) {
        G.get(u).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, 0, capacity));
        G.get(v).add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0));
    }

    static int[] ptr = new int[1001];
    static int[] dist = new int[1001];

    static boolean findPath() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        Q.add(source);
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = Q.poll();
            for (int id : G.get(u)) {
                int v = e.get(id).v;
                if (dist[v] == -1 && e.get(id).flow < e.get(id).capacity) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    Q.add(v);
                    if (v == sink) return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static long sendFlow(int u, long flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        for (; ptr[u] < G.get(u).size(); ++ptr[u]) {
            int id = G.get(u).get(ptr[u]);
            int v = e.get(id).v;
            if (dist[v] != dist[u] + 1) continue;
            long pushed = sendFlow(v, Math.min(flow, e.get(id).capacity - e.get(id).flow));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                e.get(id).flow += pushed;
                e.get(id ^ 1).flow -= pushed;
                return pushed;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static long dinics() {
        long flow = 0;
        while (findPath()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            long pushed;
            while ((pushed = sendFlow(source, infinity)) > 0)
                flow += pushed;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    static String[] scientists = new String[101];
    static String[] reactors = new String[101];
    static int[][][][] isReachable = new int[10][10][10][10];
    static int[][] visited = new int[101][101];
    static int[][] becomesUnusableAt = new int[10][10];
    static int n, m;

    static boolean isValid(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && c >= 0 && r < n && c < m;
    }

    static int getID(int x, int y) {
        return 1 + m * x + y;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T;
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        T = scanner.nextInt();
        T++; // The original code does ++T after reading T, so we simulate that.
        m = n;
        sink = m * m + m * m + 1;
        source = 0;
        G = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < m * m * 2 + 2; i++) G.add(new ArrayList<>());
        e = new ArrayList<>();
        
        Queue<Pair<Integer, Integer>> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
            scientists[i] = scanner.next();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            reactors[i] = scanner.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {
                becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                if (reactors[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    Q.add(new Pair<>(i, j));
                    becomesUnusableAt[i][j] = 1;
                }
            }
        }

        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = Q.peek().first;
            int y = Q.peek().second;
            Q.poll();
            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; ++i) {
                for (int j = -1; j <= 1; ++j) {
                    if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) == 1) {
                        int nx = x + i;
                        int ny = y + j;
                        if (isValid(nx, ny) && becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] == Integer.MAX_VALUE && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                            becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny] = becomesUnusableAt[x][y] + 1;
                            Q.add(new Pair<>(nx, ny));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        /* build graph */
        for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 0; y < m; ++y) {
                if (scientists[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && scientists[x].charAt(y) <= '9')
                    addEdge(source, getID(x, y), scientists[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                if (reactors[x].charAt(y) >= '1' && reactors[x].charAt(y) <= '9')
                    addEdge(n * n + getID(x, y), sink, reactors[x].charAt(y) - '0');
                for (int X = 0; X < n; ++X) {
                    for (int Y = 0; Y < m; ++Y) {
                        if (scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || scientists[x].charAt(y) == 'Z' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Y' || reactors[X].charAt(Y) == 'Z')
                            continue;
                        for (int[] row : visited) Arrays.fill(row, 0);
                        Queue<Triple<Pair<Integer, Integer>, Integer>> Q2 = new LinkedList<>();
                        Q2.add(new Triple<>(new Pair<>(x, y), 1));
                        visited[x][y] = 1;
                        while (!Q2.isEmpty()) {
                            int cx = Q2.peek().first.first;
                            int cy = Q2.peek().first.second;
                            int tim = Q2.peek().second;
                            Q2.poll();
                            if (cx == X && cy == Y) {
                                visited[cx][cy] = 1;
                                break;
                            }
                            if (tim >= becomesUnusableAt[cx][cy] || tim >= T)
                                continue;
                            for (int i = -1; i <= 1; ++i) {
                                for (int j = -1; j <= 1; ++j) {
                                    if (Math.abs(i) + Math.abs(j) == 1) {
                                        int nx = cx + i, ny = cy + j;
                                        if (isValid(nx, ny) && visited[nx][ny] == 0 && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && scientists[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Z' && tim + 1 <= becomesUnusableAt[nx][ny]) {
                                            visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                                            Q2.add(new Triple<>(new Pair<>(nx, ny), tim + 1));
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if (visited[X][Y] == 1) {
                            addEdge(getID(x, y), n * n + getID(X, Y), infinity);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        int ans = (int) dinics();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static class Pair<A, B> {
        A first;
        B second;
        Pair(A first, B second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static class Triple<A, B> {
        A first;
        B second;
        Triple(A first, B second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }
}
